relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: Allocates a CRL object via gnutls_x509_crl_init(crl), storing the heap pointer in *crl. This allocation is triggered when a GNUTLS_BAG_CRL element is found in the PKCS12 bag parsed from the attacker-controlled input.

After gnutls_x509_crl_import fails, gnutls_x509_crl_deinit(*crl) frees the CRL object but *crl is not set to NULL. The stale pointer remains in *crl, causing the done: cleanup to call gnutls_x509_crl_deinit a second time on freed memory. The fix adds `*crl = NULL;` after this deinit call.

Reads crl->crl (8 bytes) from the already-freed CRL object. This is the second invocation of gnutls_x509_crl_deinit on the same pointer, triggered by the cleanup code at pkcs12.c:1791 which passes the stale *crl value.

edges.description: The stale *crl pointer value from the error-path deinit at line 1745 propagates unchanged to the cleanup deinit at line 1791. Because *crl was not set to NULL, the cleanup guard passes and calls gnutls_x509_crl_deinit with the freed pointer.
